archetypes.rationale: 111 of 271 cards carry the Artifacts tag; count payoffs (Emissary Escort, Warmaker Gunship) scale with density while Sami grants affinity and Mm'menon casts artifacts off the library.
Six 'two or more tapped creatures' payoffs plus seven 'becomes tapped' engines; Station taps creatures as fuel for both; found via keyword scan, no tag covers it.
Terrasymbiosis converts counters to cards, Loading Zone doubles them, Ouroboroid snowballs every combat; 43 tagged sources across the curve.
32 token producers under two multipliers (Exalted Sunborn doubles, Moonlit Meditation copies); Starwinder converts wide combat damage into cards.
The 31-card Sacrifice cluster merges with the untagged Void suite ('a nonland permanent left the battlefield this turn'); fodder deaths switch on removal, draw and equipment every turn.
Lander tokens convert every color's fodder into landfall triggers; ten typed duals feed the 'differently named lands' payoffs (Fungal Colossus, All-Fates Scroll, Survey Mechan).
Eight recursion effects across three colors backed by a deep mill/surveil suite; Bygone Colossus is a 9/9 that loses nothing to Xu-Ifit's 'no abilities' clause.
~30 warp cards double every ETB; Starfield Vocalist doubles the triggers again; Cosmogoyf counts warp-stocked exile; warping also flips Void cards on.
Five 'second spell each turn' payoffs plus cost reducers; Weftwalking's free first spell and seven fresh cards make the second spell trivial.
Haliya converts incidental gain into cards; Ragost turns all artifacts into Foods and drains per sacrifice; Space-Time Anomaly mills an opponent for your (high) life total.
Seven Equipment plus two aura payoffs with a battlefield tutor; Hylderblade self-attaches on Void turns; Dominion Bracelet's ability cost shrinks with carrier power.
Three mana engines plus rocks and Landers power out 7-9 mana payloads; Sledge-Class Seedship and Terminal Velocity cheat them in early.
Single payoff exiles the top card off every Kavu ETB, but nine red-based Kavu mean the engine runs on creatures a red drafter plays anyway.
Tapestry Warden makes toughness-heavy bodies hit and station with toughness; Requiem Monolith turns damage dealt to them into card draw.
One payoff gives two poison per nontoken artifact-creature connect, and the cube is saturated with cheap evasive nontoken artifact creatures; tokens don't count.
'Whenever an opponent discards, they lose 3 life' from one charge counter; Beetle and Intervention force discards and the ward costs on Alpharael and Saboteur tax removal for 3.
